        import sys as _s
        _s.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); import fib
        def special(rng, target):
            routes={(0,0):7}; rows=[["::/0",7]]
            hop=3
            while True:
                v=rng.getrandbits(127)&~((1<<24)-1)
                length=rng.choice([128,64,48,32])
                size=1<<(128-length); v=(v//size)*size
                if (v,length) in routes: continue
                trial=dict(routes); trial[(v,length)]=hop
                if len(fib.runs_of(trial)[0])<=target:
                    routes=trial; rows.append([str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v))+"/%d"%length,hop]); hop+=1
                    if len(fib.runs_of(routes)[0])>=target: return rows
        cases=[]
        for k in range(4):
            rows=special(rng,4)+[["::/0",7]]
            for _ in range(1700):
                length=rng.choice([128,120,112,96,64,48])
                v=rng.getrandbits(128); size=1<<(128-length)
                rows.append([str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v//size*size))+"/%d"%length, 7])
